question: Task card B: Explain how community volunteering may benefit university students.
transcript: I believe volunteering gives students a chance to develop practical communication skills. One reason is that real community problems require patience and teamwork. For example, I once joined a reading program for children, and our group had to adjust the activities when some children lost interest. That taught me to listen before offering advice. Volunteering can also broaden our view of the people living around us. In conclusion, students can learn responsibility through service, so universities should make volunteering opportunities easy to find, while allowing students to decide how much time to spend.
